field.name: bin_lifted_ids
field.invisible: hide_droppoff_container_ids_placement or (not hide_droppoff_container_ids_collection and not hide_lifted_bin_ids_swap and not hide_shunt_container_ids and not hide_droppoff_container_ids_removal) or hide_tank_volume

field.name: bin_dropped_ids

field.name: bin_dropped_ids
field.invisible: not hide_lifted_bin_ids_swap or (not hide_general and hide_shunt_container_ids)

field.name: dropoff_point_ids

field.name: truck_tanker_id

field.name: liters_collected
